notes.title: Update 1.0.7: Origins Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34942155/4735e5b35d145d1941a1112ee006f92f9faef23d.png[/img]

Update 1.0.7 is here!
Ever wanted to hunt a deer, but don't own a gun? Got stuck on a rock again? Fear no more for we have just the update for you!
Origins adds a fresh new gamemode with a new map, new AI, but all with an old idea: the original pitch to The Deer.

Changelog:[list][*]Added New Gamemode, Origins.
[*]Added a dev button that allows clipping through colliders in the event of getting stuck
[*]Fixed cabin colliders
[*]Fixed rock colliders
[*]Fixed fading before orange2
[*]Fixed pathfinding
[*]Fixed table collider
[/list]

As of this update releasing, the steam lunar new year sale is still going on so be sure to pick it up if you don't already own it for 20% off!

Feel free to join our discord as well: https://discord.gg/CD9jwKx

tags.feature: [*]Added a dev button that allows clipping through colliders in the event of getting stuck
